title_as_printed: Composition of the Phase Rich in Carbon Dioxide in Equilibrium with the Phase Rich in Water (G. H2O per Liter of Expanded Gas at S. T. P.)
pressure_note: 'Total press., atm.'; gauge/absolute not stated; the 1 atm row is the atmospheric-pressure saturation value

value.col: g H2O per liter of expanded gas at S.T.P.
value.what: grams of water per litre of the CO2-rich phase after expansion to S.T.P.

volume_basis_evidence: 'G. H2O per Liter of Expanded Gas at S. T. P.' (gas-phase volume, not solution or solvent)

conversion_needs: g H2O per litre of expanded gas at STP to mole fraction: STP molar volume (0 C, 1 atm assumed) and water molar mass; assumes expanded-gas volume counts CO2 only
